003.text: Rin Satsuki has beaten Remilia Scarlet.

013.name: Remilia
013.text: Gah! Fine, I'll stop the ritual.

015.name: Remilia
015.text: What do humans love so much about the sun anyway?

016.name: Remilia
016.text: All it does is make thing unbearably hot.

017.name: Rin
017.text: Isn't the sun vital for all life?

018.name: Remilia
018.text:
No idea, vampires are classified as
			undead, remember?

019.name: Rin
019.text: Well, let my try to explain.

021.name: Rin
021.text: The sun allows us to see and feel the world around us.

022.name: Rin
022.text:
It illuminates with a light that can't be found anywhere else.
			Its presence reminds us of a guardian figure that was always there
			since we were born.

023.name: Rin
023.text:
When I look at the red moon, it feels like I've been under this
			scarlet sky my whole life.

024.name: Rin
024.text:
Never seeing the worldbeyond, suffocating under a devil's
			illusion.

025.name: Rin
025.text: I think a quiet and dark world would get pretty lonely.

026.name: Rin
026.text: Even so, I'm glad to have ventured out today.

027.name: Rin
027.text: But only if I have a home to return too.

028.name: Remilia
028.text:
Humans and youkai are different after all.
			I don't understand a word you are saying.

031.name: Remilia
031.text:
This project was started because my sister, who locked
			herself in the basement, refuses to go out.

032.name: Remilia
032.text:
'The sun is always too bright!', she says. 'Nighttime is
			so boring!

033.name: Remilia
033.text:
I was hoping vampirizing the sky would 
			allow us to go out together.

035.name: Remilia
035.text: Ah, but I've heard you worked at a school, yes?

036.name: Remilia
036.text: In that case, I'd like to ask you for a small favor.

038.text:
Congratulations!
			Start the Extra Stage to continue the story.
